name: v16_acquisition_sales_contribution_margin
hypothesis: Acquisition sales contribution may capture demand/scale benefits from deals, distinct from v15's income contribution. Gross margin and low goodwill burden filter low-quality acquisitions without using CFO or intraday reversal.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqs / sales, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * goodwill / assets, 126), industry)
notes: First fnd6_aqs test; no close/open and no cashflow_op to reduce correlation with 9qwXgvQd.

name: v16_acquisition_after_tax_eps_value
hypothesis: Positive acquisition/merger after-tax contribution should matter when valuation is not stretched. Use analyst EPS yield and low leverage as slow stabilizers.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newqeventv110_aqaq / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt / assets, 126), industry)
notes: Uses after-tax acquisition field rather than fnd6_aqi; no reversal/CFO.

name: v16_acquisition_pretax_relationship
hypothesis: Acquisition pretax contribution may work better when firms also sit in strong customer networks. Relationship authority is an orthogonal stabilizer to accounting quality.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newqeventv110_aqpq / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests pretax acquisition event contribution with relationship data, avoiding close/open.

name: v16_acquisition_eps_effect_combo
hypothesis: Acquisition-related EPS effect should be valued differently from raw income contribution. Combine it with sales contribution and EPS yield.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_eventv110_aqepsq / close, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqs / sales, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)
notes: Sparse EPS-effect field; strict submit gate expected.

name: v16_aqi_low_debt_eps
hypothesis: The v15 acquisition-income signal may diversify if paired with low leverage and EPS yield instead of CFO and close/open reversal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqi / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)
notes: Direct v15 sibling but removes CFO/reversal and lowers fnd6_aqi weight; submit only if self-corr to 9qwXgvQd is low.

name: v16_aqi_credit_ratings_news
hypothesis: Acquisition income contribution may be more valuable when credit-rating news is favorable, capturing financing quality rather than operating cashflow quality.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqi / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)
notes: Hybrid accounting + credit-ratings news; no close/open.

name: v16_goodwill_growth_eps_authority
hypothesis: v15 goodwill growth was strong but too correlated with deferred revenue. Replace operating quality/reversal with EPS yield and customer authority to lower common quality/reversal exposure.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(goodwill, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Rescue variant for RRp70j8d; no close/open or operating_income.

name: v16_deferred_tax_allowance_eps_authority
hypothesis: v15 deferred-tax allowance was strong but too correlated with goodwill quality. Replace operating quality/reversal with EPS yield and customer authority.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * deferred_tax_assets_valuation_allowance_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Rescue variant for Xgp7XlVx; submit only if corr to mL8j98w9 and 9qwXgvQd stays below threshold.
